description: Shared manifest fixture, run by tools/manifest_check.py and sdk/manifest (Go). Each case builds one input: base+patch (RFC 6902 add/replace/remove on the parsed base, then re-encoded as UTF-8 JSON; patch values hold only strings, booleans, null, small integers, arrays and objects), base+edit (on the base file text: replace = [[find, replacement]] each found exactly once, then append, then pad_to = pad with spaces to that many bytes), raw (UTF-8 text), raw_b64 (bytes) or raw_repeat (concatenation of s repeated n times). expect is accept or reject; for reject, code (and pointer, when both sides can compute it) must be among the reported violations. base names a file in ../examples/.
